record.original_question: For the many asymptotically locally conical G2-manifolds that are close to a degenerate Calabi-Yau cone limit and are typically only U(1)-invariant, can one construct G2-instantons that are correspondingly close, in an appropriate sense, to Calabi-Yau monopoles on the limiting cone?

evidence.quote: It has been shown that [FHN17] there are many ALC G2-manifolds which are close to the degenerate Calabi-Yau cone limit, and the typical example will only be U(1)-invariant. It is therefore interesting to attempt to construct G2-instantons on these ALC G2-manifolds which are, in a sense, close to Calabi-Yau monopoles on the cone.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Setup. Let $(C,g_C)$ be a Calabi-Yau cone of complex dimension $3$, and let $(M,\varphi,g)$ be a complete asymptotically locally conical (ALC) $G_2$-manifold of dimension $7$, meaning that outside a compact set $M$ is diffeomorphic to a circle bundle over the link of $C$ whose $G_2$-structure $\varphi$ approaches, with suitable decay, the product of $g_C$ with the standard metric on a circle of fixed asymptotic length. Assume $M$ lies in a one-parameter family of ALC $G_2$-manifolds that collapses, as the asymptotic circle length tends to $0$, to the Calabi-Yau cone $C$ in the Gromov-Hausdorff sense (the "degenerate Calabi-Yau cone limit"); in particular such $M$ may have only a $U(1)$ symmetry (acting by rotation of the asymptotic circle fibers).
   
A $G_2$-instanton on a principal $G$-bundle $P \to M$ is a connection $A$ whose curvature $F_A$ satisfies $F_A \wedge \psi = 0$, where $\psi = *\varphi$ is the coassociative $4$-form. A Calabi-Yau monopole on $C$ is a pair $(B,\Phi)$ consisting of a connection $B$ and a Higgs field $\Phi$ on a principal $G$-bundle over $C$ satisfying $F_B \wedge \tfrac{1}{2}\omega^2 = *_{C}\, d_B\Phi$, where $\omega$ is the Kähler form of the Calabi-Yau structure on $C$.
   
Problem. For ALC $G_2$-manifolds $M$ close to the degenerate Calabi-Yau cone limit (and in particular for examples that are only $U(1)$-invariant rather than enjoying larger continuous symmetry), construct $G_2$-instantons on $M$ that, in the collapsing limit, converge in an appropriate gauge-theoretic sense to a prescribed Calabi-Yau monopole $(B,\Phi)$ on the cone $C$. More precisely, given a Calabi-Yau monopole $(B,\Phi)$ on $C$, produce a family of $G_2$-instantons $A_\epsilon$ on the corresponding ALC $G_2$-manifolds $M_\epsilon$ (parameterized by the asymptotic circle length $\epsilon$) such that $A_\epsilon$ converges to $(B,\Phi)$ as $\epsilon \to 0$, with $\Phi$ recovered from the component of $A_\epsilon$ along the collapsing circle.
artifact.status_search_result: Recent work (e.g., the 2025 study of the large-mass limit of G2 and Calabi-Yau monopoles, and related works on invariant gauge theory on asymptotically conical Calabi-Yau 3-folds) develops structural results in the Donaldson-Segal programme connecting Calabi-Yau monopoles to G2-instantons via collapse, and constructs explicit invariant G2-instantons in highly symmetric examples (e.g., SU(2)^2-invariant settings on the spinor bundle of S^3). However, no general construction of G2-instantons on the merely U(1)-invariant ALC G2-manifolds close to a degenerate Calabi-Yau cone limit, converging to Calabi-Yau monopoles on the cone, appears to have been carried out. The problem appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: The large mass limit of G2 and Calabi-Yau monopoles
status_evidence.snippet: Develops a structure theory for the limit of SU(2) G2-monopoles (resp. Calabi-Yau monopoles) on asymptotically conical G2-manifolds as the mass parameter tends to infinity; notes that 'the full Donaldson-Segal programme is much more ambitious than our main theorems.'
status_evidence.claim: Recent results address related limits but do not construct G2-instantons on ALC G2-manifolds from Calabi-Yau monopoles on the cone.

status_evidence.title: Complete non-compact G2-manifolds from asymptotically conical Calabi-Yau 3-folds
status_evidence.snippet: Constructs infinitely many 1-parameter families of complete ALC G2-manifolds collapsing to asymptotically conical Calabi-Yau 3-folds; typical examples are only U(1)-invariant.
status_evidence.claim: Provides the ALC G2-manifolds on which the instanton construction is sought.

status_evidence.title: Invariant Gauge Theory on Asymptotically Conical Calabi-Yau 3-folds
status_evidence.snippet: Provides Calabi-Yau instantons and monopoles with SU(2)^2 symmetry on asymptotically conical Calabi-Yau 3-folds, including bubbling and moduli space classification.
status_evidence.claim: Calabi-Yau monopoles on the limiting cone (the input data) have been constructed in symmetric settings.
